note_densite.en: Cross-analysis over {observations} cantons (robustness threshold: {seuil}). {faible} comes last with {valeur} facility per 10,000 inhabitants. This ratio covers only ALREADY recorded cantons: the others are absent for lack of an inventory.

note_densite_insuffisante.en: Too few cross-matched cantons to publish this ratio.

note_series.en: {premier} leads with {volume} m³ across {categories} categories. Lines are not stitched: gaps are collection gaps, and filling them would invent volumes.

note_national.fr: Ces volumes sont publiés au niveau national uniquement. Ils n'entrent dans aucun croisement territorial de ce tableau de bord : les répartir par région reviendrait à fabriquer la répartition.
note_national.en: These volumes are published at national level only. They enter no territorial cross-analysis in this dashboard: splitting them by region would mean manufacturing the split.

note_pentes.fr: Les courbes se croisent : les cantons les plus peuplés ne sont pas les mieux dotés. {croisement} des {observations} cantons croisés perdent au moins cinq places entre les deux classements. Attention toutefois — ce classement ne porte que sur les ouvrages RECENSÉS.
note_pentes.en: The curves cross: the most populated cantons are not the best provided. {croisement} of the {observations} cross-matched cantons drop at least five places between the two rankings. Note, though — this ranking covers RECORDED facilities only.
